movesets.name: Assault Vest
movesets.description:
Hoopa-U takes advantage of its staggering mixed attacking stats, coverage options, and STAB Knock Off and Psychic Noise to become a solid stallbreaker in the metagame. Simultaneously, the Assault Vest and physical bulk investment slightly improve its matchup against offensive teams, capable of trading hits decently well; in particular, Assault Vest magnifies Hoopa-U's natural special bulk to soft check common threats like Gholdengo, Darkrai, Kyurem, and Raging Bolt. Knock Off can remove valuable items like Heavy-Duty Boots and Leftovers from foes like Ting-Lu and Alomomola, while Psychic Noise can shut down the recovery of Gliscor and Clefable, with an even wider range of Pokemon falling victim to both moves, including common defensive staples like Garganacl, Moltres, Clodsire, and Dondozo. Psychic Noise has the added benefit of stopping Hatterene and Primarina's Draining Kiss, letting Hoopa-U potentially win the one-on-one. Aside from providing Hoopa-U with decent longevity, Drain Punch reliably hits Dark-types like Ting-Lu, Darkrai, and Kingambit as well as common Tera Dark users like Clodsire, which can attempt to heal in the face of Hoopa-U's Psychic Noise. Thunderbolt immediately nails physically defensive Water- and Flying-types like Alomomola, Dondozo, Moltres, and Corviknight. On top of working well with Tera Poison, Gunk Shot is another option to threaten common Fairy-types and Tera Fairy users like Primarina, Hatterene, Clefable, Raging Bolt, and Gholdengo while netting the OHKO against Ogerpon-W; the poison chance is also handy against foes like Ting-Lu. The Special Attack EVs allow Hoopa-U to OHKO Keldeo with Psychic Noise, with the remaining Defense EVs letting it reach benchmarks such as surviving Ogerpon-W's Power Whip after Stealth Rock, +1 Tera Normal Dragonite's Extreme Speed after Stealth Rock, and +1 Speed Booster Energy Great Tusk's Headlong Rush. If not running Gunk Shot, then a spread of 252 HP / 156 Def / 100 SpA can be used instead, running enough Special Attack to OHKO Enamorus with Thunderbolt. Tera Fairy provides a generally valuable defensive typing against the metagame's Dragon- and Dark-types like Dragapult, Raging Bolt, Kyurem, and Weavile, while Tera Poison flips its Fairy weakness from foes like Iron Valiant, Enamorus, and Primarina. Both Tera types provide a crucial U-turn resistance against pivots like Landorus-T, Dragapult, Cinderace, and Rillaboom as well as letting it stomach otherwise fearsome Fighting-type attacks from Zamazenta and physical Iron Valiant.

Hoopa-U works well on balance and bulky offense teams that appreciate its role compression as a strong stallbreaker and special tank. Defensive pivots like Galarian Slowking, Alomomola, Corviknight, Zapdos, and Moltres are necessary teammates; aside from bringing Hoopa-U into the field safely, they can deal with and switch into troublesome offensive threats that can overrun Hoopa-U, such as Enamorus, Hisuian Samurott, and Weavile. Moreover, Moltres, Zapdos, and Corviknight can punish otherwise no-drawback U-turns aimed at Hoopa-U from foes like Rillaboom, Landorus-T, and Ogerpon-W with Flame Body, Static, and Rocky Helmet, while Alomomola provides crucial Wish support for Hoopa-U. The aforementioned Corviknight as well as other entry hazard control options like Great Tusk and Cinderace also keep Hoopa-U healthy by removing troublesome hazards. The team's own entry hazards from setters like Garganacl, Gliscor, and Clefable are similarly important, as they take advantage of the switches that Hoopa-U forces and further exacerbates its ability to suffocate defensive teams, especially because it makes Heavy-Duty Boots users like Alomomola and Moltres vulnerable to them with Knock Off. Landorus-T is a phenomenal partner on bulky offense teams that similarly covers all of the aforementioned traits; it brings Hoopa-U in safely via U-turn, sets Stealth Rock, and switches into physical attackers like Great Tusk, Cinderace, and opposing Landorus-T. Other wallbreakers like Gholdengo and Raging Bolt can further pressure the opposition together with Hoopa-U, with Gholdengo also capable of defensively covering for its weaknesses against Iron Valiant. Hoopa-U works well with late-game cleaners like Zamazenta that appreciate its positive matchup against bulky teams that they tend to struggle with; in particular, Hoopa-U's ability to either threaten or overwhelm the likes of Dondozo, Moltres, and Clefable makes it take over games more easily. Furthermore, it also complements Hoopa-U by excelling against offensive teams that Hoopa-U has a harder time keeping up with, either offensively threatening or defensively handling foes like Kingambit and Weavile. Other offensive threats like Dragapult are great teammates too, with it in particular capable of bringing Hoopa-U on the field safely via U-turn and crippling foes like Kingambit with status to improve Hoopa-U's matchup against them.

strategies.comments:
Other Options

Dark (Choice Specs)

A Timid nature allows Hoopa-U to outspeed Rash Kommo-o and Timid Heatran, which it can OHKO with Psychic and Focus Blast. It also enables Hoopa-U to punish common base 80 Speed Pokemon that are running an Attack-boosting nature like Adamant Dragonite and Mamoswine.

Dark (Choice Scarf)

Gunk Shot is great for threatening Fairy- and Grass-types like Primarina, Hatterene, and the Ogerpon formes. Focus Blast is another option to OHKO Archaludon, but its low accuracy is unappealing. Destiny Bond is a weird catch-all move that notably lets you trade with the Ogerpon formes, but it is very unreliable.

Psychic (Assault Vest)

Expanding Force can be used over Psychic and Psychic Noise if Hoopa-U is being paired with Indeedee-M. Gunk Shot can enable Hoopa-U to easily remove Hatterene and Primarina without any issues; however, its shaky accuracy and lack of use cases outside of hitting slow Fairy-types aren't ideal.

movesets.name: Choice Specs (Dark)
movesets.description:
Hoopa-U is an unparalleled wallbreaker in the metagame, 2HKOing even the bulkiest walls like Corviknight and Empoleon with Dark Pulse, and its coverage also packs a punch to beat its would-be checks. Psychic OHKOes Fighting- and Poison-type Pokemon such as defensive Great Tusk, Iron Hands, Okidogi, and Toxapex. Psyshock can help break past Calm Mind users such as Primarina as well as physically defensive Quiver Dance Volcarona, Flutter Mane if it tries to switch in, Assault Vest Gallade, and Blissey. Thunderbolt OHKOes physically defensive Mandibuzz and Hisuian Samurott if the latter tries to switch in while also having a chance to OHKO Corviknight after Stealth Rock. Focus Blast can 2HKO Dark-types like Ting-Lu, Scrafty, and Alolan Muk that can otherwise stomach all of Hoopa-U's attacks while also being able to 2HKO Hisuian Goodra. 8 Special Defense EVs allow Hoopa-U to always tank Choice Scarf Flutter Mane's Moonblast from full HP.

Choice Specs Hoopa-U should be safely brought into battle via U-turn from Mandibuzz or Meowscarada. Mandibuzz switches into physical threats such as Choice Scarf Urshifu-R and Ogerpon-H, easily healing with Roost and walling them. It also provides a ton of utility for Hoopa-U, being able to clear entry hazards with Defog. On the other hand, Choice Scarf Meowscarada can safely bring in Hoopa-U with U-turn by forcing switches into physical walls that Hoopa-U can break. It can also handle faster threats such as Choice Specs Flutter Mane, Roaring Moon, and Urshifu-R, which otherwise OHKO Hoopa-U. Ting-Lu sets Stealth Rock, allowing Hoopa-U to OHKO Pokemon such as Corviknight and Assault Vest Tornadus-T, while easily tanking special attacks. In particular, it can take Moonblast from Choice Scarf Flutter Mane and OHKO back with Heavy Slam. Choice Specs Greninja can take care of threats such as non-Choice Scarf variants of Sneasler and Iron Valiant with Extrasensory, Ogerpon-H and Hatterene with Sludge Wave, and Ceruledge with Surf. It can also help Hoopa-U pressure Flying and Dragon teams with Ice Beam. Choice Scarf Greninja can offensively check faster threats, including Dragapult and common Choice Scarf users like Landorus and Great Tusk. The Spikes that Hisuian Samurott's Ceaseless Edge sets help Hoopa-U force progress throughout the game. Additionally, Hisuian Samurott can break past Pokemon such as Hisuian Goodra and Alolan Muk that can give it trouble while also helping Hoopa-U apply pressure and win late-game scenarios against Ghost and Dragon teams.

movesets.name: Assault Vest (Psychic)
movesets.description:
Assault Vest Hoopa-U serves as a great defensive and offensive piece for Psychic teams, easily handling the likes of Kyurem and Gholdengo for its teammates. Psychic is Hoopa-U's strongest offensive option, handling threats like Iron Moth and Walking Wake. Alternatively, Psychic Noise, while a drop in power, enables Hoopa-U to greatly impede the likes of Hatterene and Calm Mind Primarina by denying them access to Draining Kiss. Knock Off threatens opposing Ghost- and Psychic-types like Gholdengo, Flutter Mane, and Latios, along with hindering checks to Hoopa-U and its teammates reliant on their held items such as Assault Vest Tornadus-T and Alolan Muk. Focus Blast rips through Steel- and Dark-types like Archaludon, Heatran, and Darkrai. Drain Punch can also be used over Focus Blast to better handle Blissey and Hisuian Goodra. Finally, Thunderbolt shocks Flying- and Water-types such as Skarmory and Slowbro. The given EV spread allows Hoopa-U to outspeed Modest Magnezone while only having a minor chance of being 2HKOed by Choice Scarf Flutter Mane's Moonblast after a layer of Spikes.

With its low physical bulk and less-than-stellar Speed, Hoopa-U is greatly reliant on teammates such as Hatterene and Slowbro to come in and check foes like Kleavor while providing speed control through Nuzzle and Thunder Wave, respectively, allowing Hoopa-U to outspeed threats such as Hisuian Zoroark and opposing Hoopa-U. Hatterene checks Dark-types like Choice Scarf Meowscarada and Roaring Moon for Hoopa-U, along with preventing status and entry hazards from foes such as Gliscor and Ting-Lu with Magic Bounce. Slowbro, meanwhile, can assist against Fire- and Water-types like Cinderace, Hisuian Arcanine, and Urshifu-R and use Body Press to help break through Dark-types like Hisuian Samurott if using a Colbur Berry or go itemless to handle Ceruledge and physical Hisuian Zoroark. Metagross provides Stealth Rock for Hoopa-U, wearing down checks such as Scizor and Tornadus-T and using Bullet Punch to pick off faster targets like Mamoswine, Iron Valiant, and Flutter Mane. Choice Specs Latios provides a nice Ground immunity through Levitate, enabling it to help ward off Landorus and Gliscor while also using options such as Draco Meteor to cleanly remove the likes of Kyurem and Dragonite. Choice Scarf Indeedee-M can check Ghost-types like Ceruledge and Spectrier due to its Normal typing, along with using Healing Wish to keep Hoopa-U healthy in a pinch. Indeedee-M also sets Psychic Terrain with its ability Psychic Surge, preventing Hoopa-U from being picked off by Aqua Jet Azumarill. Choice Scarf Iron Boulder provides incredible speed control, handling faster threats like Ogerpon-H, Kleavor, and Meowscarada for Hoopa-U while greatly appreciating Hoopa-U removing physical walls like Skarmory.

movesets.name: Assault Vest (Dark)
movesets.description:
Hoopa-U, when paired with an Assault Vest, can leverage its incredible Special Defense, enabling it to come in on threats like Kyurem and Heatran and proceed to cause immense havoc with its incredible base attacking stats. Psychic and Psyshock handle Poison- and Fighting-types like Toxapex and Iron Hands for Hoopa-U's teammates; Psychic OHKOes Galarian Weezing, while Psyshock removes Flutter Mane after Stealth Rock. Knock Off cripples special walls attempting to come in such as Alolan Muk, Tornadus-T, and Articuno, making it much easier for Hoopa-U and teammates like Greninja to wear them down. Focus Blast slams Steel- and Dark-types like Archaludon, Heatran, and Darkrai. Finally, Thunderbolt handles Water- and Flying-types such as Primarina, Pelipper, and Skarmory. The given EV spread allows Hoopa-U to outspeed Modest Magnezone while only having a minor chance of being 2HKOed by Choice Scarf Flutter Mane's Moonblast after a layer of Spikes.

Hoopa-U greatly appreciates support from Mandibuzz to make up for its poor Defense, with it checking threats like Choice Scarf Great Tusk, Excadrill, Scizor, and Ogerpon-W, along with pivoting Hoopa-U in safely with U-turn. Ting-Lu can provide entry hazard support that helps to wear down would-be switch-ins like Corviknight and Assault Vest Gallade, and its Ground typing makes it great at checking Raging Bolt. Choice Band Meowscarada is a strong wallbreaker able to check Ground- and Water-types such as Ting-Lu, Swampert, and Hisuian Samurott with Flower Trick while also using Triple Axel to handily check Gliscor and Dragonite. Choice Scarf Greninja greatly enjoys Hoopa-U breaking down special walls like Hisuian Goodra and Assault Vest Gallade and in return can outspeed and check threats such as Choice Scarf Roaring Moon, the Landorus formes, Enamorus, and Iron Valiant with options like Ice Beam and Sludge Wave. Hisuian Samurott and Bisharp can provide speed control with Sucker Punch picking off faster targets like physical Dragapult and Choice Specs Flutter Mane. Hisuian Samurott can also set Spikes with Ceaseless Edge and use Sacred Sword to check Blissey comfortably, while Bisharp can handle Fairy-types like Hatterene and Clefable. Sableye packs a helpful Fighting immunity, enabling it to safely come in on the likes of Sneasler and Hisuian Lilligant and hinder them with Will-O-Wisp. Sableye can also use Encore to trap walls like Articuno and Clodsire into their recovery options, allowing Hoopa-U to get onto the field safely.

movesets.name: Choice Band (Psychic)
movesets.description:
Hoopa-U is one of Psychic's best physical wallbreakers. Its strong offensive STAB combination coupled with great coverage allows it to muscle through bulky Pokemon such as Skeledirge, Toxapex, Iron Hands, and Amoonguss, and with its great special bulk, it can prove useful against Ghost teams. Drain Punch grants Hoopa-U super effective coverage against Dark- and Steel-types such as Ting-Lu and Heatran. Brick Break can also be run as Hoopa-U's Fighting-type move, as this allows it to remove dual screens set by Fairy- and Dark-type teams. Trick is a great option for Hoopa-U to hinder Pokemon that can take a hit like Sableye and Klefki, as well as potentially disrupt Pokemon reliant on their items such as Moltres. Gunk Shot is another great option, as it allows Hoopa-U to threaten Fairy-types like Azumarill and to OHKO Hatterene. By investing 8 EVs in Special Defense, Hoopa-U can live a Moonblast from Choice Scarf Flutter Mane.

Azelf and Scream Tail make for great partners, as they can set up entry hazards for Hoopa-U to be able to wallbreak more easily. Azelf can also run Taunt to prevent Defog users like Corviknight removing its hazards, while Scream Tail can also set up dual screens for both Hoopa-U and its teammates and provide Wish support. Because of Hoopa-U's lack of longevity outside of Wish, it can get easily worn down by hazards. Hence, Hatterene is a great partner, as it is able to provide great hazard control for Psychic teams through Magic Bounce. Galarian Slowking is another great partner for Hoopa-U, as it provides Hoopa-U a switch-in to Fairy-types and aids Hoopa-U's wallbreaking through Future Sight. Galarian Slowking can also set up Toxic Spikes to annoy Hoopa-U's switch-ins such as Azumarill, and its Poison typing allows it to remove Toxic Spikes to prevent Hoopa-U from getting worn down by poison. Indeedee is another great addition to Psychic teams, as its Normal typing grants it an immunity to Ghost. Aside from this, Indeedee can set up Psychic Terrain to allow Hoopa-U to threaten Bisharp with Drain Punch without fearing Sucker Punch. Lastly, late-game sweepers such as Gallade and Armarouge appreciate Hoopa-U beating their checks such as Azumarill for the former and Galarian Slowking for the latter.

movesets.name: Choice Scarf (Psychic)
movesets.description:
Boasting stellar offenses, Choice Scarf Hoopa-U grants Psychic teams a form of speed control as well as a threatening wallbreaker, outspeeding the whole unboosted metagame bar Deoxys-S and Regieleki, especially key targets such as Choice Specs Flutter Mane and Choice Band Dragapult. Hyperspace Fury OHKOes both Flutter Mane and Dragapult and can be used to break through special tanks such as Hisuian Goodra and Galarian Slowking. Dark Pulse complements it nicely by offering a powerful neutral attack against physically bulky Steel- and Water-types like Archaludon, Iron Treads, Scizor, and Toxapex. Alternatively, Focus Blast targets Dark-type foes like Darkrai and Bisharp. Psychic covers Fighting and Fairy matchups, preventing threats like Iron Valiant and Great Tusk from switching in safely. Expanding Force is a viable alternative if the team uses Psychic Terrain, transforming Hoopa-U into a killing machine for the Terrain's duration. The last moveslot aims at targeting specific foes. Thunderbolt deals with Hisuian Samurott and Greninja, while Gunk Shot helps against the Ogerpon formes. 8 Special Defense EVs allow Hoopa-U to always survive a Moonblast from Choice Scarf Flutter Mane from full health.

Hoopa-U immensely benefits from Galarian Slowking and Hatterene; they can both support Hoopa-U in multiple ways. Galarian Slowking strengthens the wallbreaking potential of Hoopa-U with Future Sight and a slow pivoting option in the form of Chilly Reception. Hatterene can send entry hazards back to the opponent; paralyze the target with Nuzzle; take care of most Dark-types such as Roaring Moon, Hisuian Samurott, and Meowscarada; and provide Healing Wish support to Hoopa-U. Slowbro helps mitigate Hoopa-U's poor physical bulk by absorbing physical moves, spreading burns with Scald, and effectively hard-countering physical bulky setup sweepers such as Dragonite with its IronPress combination. Indeedee-M sets up Psychic Terrain, effectively negating any priority move for the Terrain's duration and massively boosting Hoopa-U's potential with Expanding Force, and has access to Healing Wish in case of need. Lastly, Hoopa-U appreciates other sweeper teammates such as Latios, Metagross, and Iron Boulder that can weaken defensive cores of types like Fairy, Flying, and Fire to allow a proper Hoopa-U sweep. Latios is especially threatening to Flying teams with access to BoltBeam coverage and a powerful STAB move in Draco Meteor, while Metagross and Iron Boulder can both offer a breaking potential similar to Latios's in Fairy and Fire matchups, respectively, with access to Heavy Slam, Bullet Punch, and Stealth Rock for Metagross and Mighty Cleave on top of naturally outspeeding both Meowscarada and Greninja for Iron Boulder.

movesets.name: Choice Scarf (Dark)
movesets.description:
Choice Scarf Hoopa-U is an amazing option on Dark teams thanks to its great Attack stat. Knock Off allows Hoopa-U to not only remove items from foes like Alolan Muk and Articuno but also takes out threats like Choice Specs Flutter Mane. Drain Punch deals with Dark-, Normal-, Steel-, and Ice-types like Greninja, Blissey, Hisuian Goodra, and Weavile, while Psychic cleans up Poison- and Fighting-types like Galarian Weezing, Okidogi, mixed attacker Iron Valiant, and Choice Specs Keldeo. Thunderbolt is a great coverage move, handling Flying- and Water-types like Skarmory, Corviknight, and Gyarados. Trick can be run over Thunderbolt to Choice-lock foes like Calm Mind Primarina, Ting-Lu, and Archaludon; however, without Thunderbolt Hoopa-U cannot reliably deal with Skarmory, which can then wall it. The given EV spread allows Hoopa-U to survive a Moonblast from Choice Scarf Flutter Mane and retaliate back with Knock Off. Its special bulk is also notable, allowing it to trade blows with the likes of Iron Valiant.

Alolan Muk is a great special wall, easing the Fairy matchup thanks to its Poison typing while dealing with Primarina and Hatterene with Poison Jab. Choice Scarf Meowscarada deals with Water-, Ground- and Fighting-types like Urshifu-R, Quagsire, and Choice Scarf Iron Valiant with Flower Trick and Play Rough. Choice Specs Greninja covers a lot of matchups thanks to Protean, notably taking out the Ogerpon formes, Hatterene, and the Landorus formes with Sludge Wave and Ice Beam. Sableye provides a Fighting immunity while also weakening physical threats like Excadrill, Sneasler, and Choice Scarf Great Tusk with Will-O-Wisp. Sableye can also use Encore on setup sweepers like Zamazenta and spread paralysis with Thunder Wave so Hoopa-U can outspeed faster threats. Mandibuzz provides entry hazard removal for Hoopa-U with Defog and slow pivoting with U-turn. Mandibuzz also checks Swords Dance sweepers like Ogerpon-H and Scizor with Foul Play. It's also worth mentioning that Mandibuzz provides a Ground immunity, which allows it to come in on Choice Scarf Great Tusk's Headlong Rush for Hoopa-U. Ting-Lu is a great wall that can lay down hazards with Stealth Rock and Spikes, which chip down threats like Iron Valiant and Zamazenta. Ting-Lu also handles Steel-types like non-Air Balloon Heatran and Hisuian Goodra with Earthquake and phazes setup sweepers like Swords Dance Garchomp and Dragon Dance Dragonite with Whirlwind. Hydreigon also sets hazards with Stealth Rock while taking out Dragon-types like Archaludon with Draco Meteor. In return, Hoopa-U deals with Skarmory, Galarian Weezing, and Iron Valiant for its teammates.

strategies.overview:
Draft Order: Round 6 onwards

Price Range: 9-11 points

Overview: Hoopa-U is a wallbreaker that uses its gargantuan offensive stats and unpredictable coverage options to become an almost impossible Pokemon to switch into. With a respectable Special Defense stat as well, it can serve as a special tank that does not require much investment in its offensive stats to muscle through teams. Hoopa-U's immediate power is most appreciated in bulky offense teams that benefit from a Pokemon that does not require turns to set up. Keeping all of this in mind, however, its slow Speed stat and debilitating weakness to U-turn limits it greatly, resulting in a cheap Pokemon that needs to be craftily built around.
strategies.comments:
Common Roles

Wallbreaker: With vast coverage options and disruptive tools like Trick and Taunt, Hoopa-U serves best as a wallbreaker. Its ability to break walls both physically and specially is unrivaled by any other Pokemon. Its strong offensive STAB combination coupled with fantastic coverage makes it near impossible to switch into, and it has special setup options to muscle past anything that could potentially switch into it. This set typically relies on Choice Scarf, since Hoopa-U's Speed is incredibly average, but in some scenarios, damage-boosting items can be effective.

Special Wall: With an Assault Vest, Hoopa-U can sponge multiple special attacks, and with access to Drain Punch, it has a way to recover any health lost back.

Common Moves

Primary STAB Moves: Knock Off, Hyperspace Fury, Dark Pulse, Psychic, Psyshock, Zen Headbutt, Psychic Noise

Setup Moves: Calm Mind, Nasty Plot

Utility Moves: Trick, Taunt, Thunder Wave, Light Screen, Reflect, Brick Break, Substitute

Coverage: Drain Punch, Energy Ball, Fire Punch, Focus Blast, Grass Knot, Gunk Shot, Ice Punch, Rock Tomb, Thunderbolt, Thunder Punch

Niche Moves

Future Sight: Hoopa-U is an incredibly strong Future Sight user, which fits well with its role as a wallbreaker.

Focus Punch: If the relatively weak Drain Punch and inaccurate Focus Blast are not reliable enough to deal with Dark-types that are not concerned about Hoopa-U's STAB options, it can use Focus Punch by taking advantage of the fact that Pokemon often switch out against it.

Trick Room: Hoopa-U's Speed is not fast enough to outspeed most offensive threats. A Trick Room set can be used as a preventative measure from being revenge killed while having multiple turns to get strong attacks off, but it must be aware of slower Pokemon that can then outspeed it.

Endure: With a Custap Berry, Hoopa-U can successfully use Endure to get a powerful final attack off.

Destiny Bond: Although Hoopa-U is too slow for Destiny Bond to always be effective, it can be used with Custap Berry as a surprise way to trade Pokemon.

Common Items

Damage-boosting Items: Although it may not seem like it needs it, Hoopa-U's efficacy is fully realized when it has an item that can boost its damage output. Seeing as it has coverage for practically every type, it arguably takes advantage of Expert Belt more than Life Orb, Choice Band, and Choice Specs, but all of them are viable.

Choice Scarf: Hoopa-U's Speed lets it outspeed most unboosted Pokemon with a Choice Scarf and serve as a niche revenge killer, and with Trick, it can give the Choice Scarf away to walls in order to benefit it and its teammates.

Assault Vest: Hoopa-U's special bulk is naturally good enough that it can safely tank a hit or two, but with an Assault Vest, it becomes something opponents has to seriously consider, especially if it is a Tera Captain and can shed its mediocre typing.

Niche Items

Eject Pack: Using Hyperspace Fury to lower its own Defense stat and get a free switch with Eject Pack, Hoopa-U can further enable its teammates while also freeing up its item slot to potentially steal an enemy's item with Magician.

Heavy-Duty Boots: In matchups where Hoopa-U is expected to hit the field multiple times or tank multiple hits, Heavy-Duty Boots ensures it does not take excess damage from entry hazards.

Custap Berry: Used in Endure sets, or even without it if properly played around, Custap Berry can allow for Hoopa-U to deliver a final attack while also having the potential to steal the foe's item with Magician afterwards, since the Custap Berry will have been eaten.

Light Clay: Hoopa-U typically likes attacking more often than not, but a Light Clay with dual screens can be used to enable both its teammates and itself to tank more hits.

Tera

Hoopa-U has an incredibly mediocre defensive typing, and being a secondary Tera Captain gives it the option to fix this. It is a great mid-tier option that can use Tera types like Tera Poison to strengthen its Gunk Shot while turning both of its weaknesses, including its major weakness to Bug, into resistances. Tera Fairy with Tera Blast gives it a more powerful option than its Fighting-type coverage against most Dark-types while also getting rid of that pesky Bug-type weakness, ensuring it does not have to worry about being free U-turn food. Tera Dark and Psychic can boost its STAB moves as well, with Tera Dark deserving a special shoutout for enabling a much more spammable Hyperspace Fury.

Draft Strategy

While Hoopa-U theoretically fits in a large variety of draft compositions, bulky offense is usually able to support it best, giving enough tools to it so that it does not need to be the sole damage dealer on a team. Its weaknesses are easily exploitable, and as a result, all of them need to be patched up in order to effectively use it.

Defensive Pivots: Hoopa-U greatly appreciates Pokemon that can switch into U-turn without losing too much momentum such as Tornadus-T, Landorus-T, and Great Tusk.

Slow Pivots: Slower Pokemon that can get Hoopa-U on the battlefield safely, like Scizor, Empoleon, and Rotom-W, are important in making sure Hoopa-U is able to safely get attacks off. Pokemon that can punish U-turn with contact effects, like Garchomp, Zapdos, and Rocky Helmet users, are a bonus.

Setup Sweepers: Pokemon like Iron Valiant, Salamence, and Annihilape that do not necessarily have as much of an immediate field presence as Hoopa-U appreciate it softening up the field for them.

Speed Control: Hoopa-U's middling Speed means that it needs a couple of fast Pokemon such as Iron Bundle and Sneasler to serve as revenge killers, and other speed control options like Thunder Wave Gholdengo and Glare Serperior can also make its job much easier. Sticky Web users such as Vikavolt and Ribombee are useful supplementary speed control options that may force opponents to slightly shift their attention away from Hoopa-U.

Checks and Counters

U-turn: If it is not a Tera Captain, Hoopa-U's one true archenemy is U-turn, since foes can deal huge damage to it while maintaining positive momentum. It constantly has to be wary of being knocked out by stray U-turn users like Cinderace, Urshifu-S, and Sneasler.

Faster Physical Threats: Physical attackers that naturally outspeed Hoopa-U, such as Ogerpon-W, Gouging Fire, and Excadrill, have no problem taking advantage of its feeble physical defense to get a KO on it.

Fairy-types: Although they have to fear Hoopa-U's Gunk Shot, Fairy-types like Clefable, Iron Valiant, and Tinkaton can still switch into its Dark-type STAB moves and threaten it back, especially if it is Choice-locked.

Dark-types: Dark-types like Ting-Lu, Zarude, and Hisuian Samurott are not concerned with either of Hoopa-U's STAB options and can threaten it back, but they have to be wary of its Fighting-type coverage options.

movesets.name: Choice Band
movesets.description:
• Hyperspace Fury targets Psychic-types like Iron Crown and Metagross as well as Ghost-types such as Skeledirge and Pecharunt.
  • Gunk Shot deals with Fairy-types such as non-Kebia Berry Azumarill, non-Custap Berry Primarina, and Sylveon.
  • Hoopa-U's last two moveslots are highly customizable. Zen Headbutt can handle Poison-types like Okidogi. Drain Punch allows Hoopa-U to beat Darkrai. Fire Punch beats non-Occa Berry Scizor, while Ice Punch is for non-Weakness Policy Galarian Moltres as well as Landorus; however, it should be noted that both Landorus formes can run U-turn to beat Hoopa-U.
  • Hoopa-U's HP and Special Defense EVs are to survive a Timid Choice Scarf Porygon-Z's Hyper Beam, with the rest put in Attack and Speed.
  • Hoopa-U can utilize an alternative EV spread of 240 HP / 252 Def / 16 Spe with an Impish nature to survive strong physical attacks from Meowscarada while also outspeeding Adamant Donphan and Iron Hands.
  • Hoopa-U struggles against Fairy- and Bug-type foes such as Iron Valiant and Volcarona, so Fire-type teammates such as Skeledirge and Volcanion are appreciated. Fast Choice Band Hoopa-U also struggles against faster physical attackers such as Ogerpon-W and Meowscarada; therefore, physical walls as partners like Pecharunt are helpful.

movesets.name: Choice Specs
movesets.description:
• Psychic Noise is used over Psychic, as it allows Hoopa-U to defeat Serperior.
  • Dark Pulse should be used against non-Disable Spectrier and Cresselia.
  • Thunderbolt allows Hoopa-U to beat Corviknight.
  • Grass Knot is for Rhyperior, while Focus Blast is strong into Hisuian Goodra.
  • Choice Specs Hoopa-U can use 52 HP EVs to survive Leaf Storm twice from non-Special Attack-invested Serperior. Additionally, 252 Speed EVs without a boosting nature allow Hoopa-U to outspeed Corviknight while also having the best odds against opposing Choice Specs Hoopa-U. The rest of the EVs and a Modest nature allow for maximum damage output.
  • Choice Specs Hoopa-U can also use an EV spread of 228 HP / 252 Def / 12 SpA / 16 Spe to survive Giga Impact from Assault Vest Ursaluna while outspeeding Adamant Donphan. The remaining EVs and a Modest nature allow for the best damage output while running this spread.

movesets.name: Choice Scarf
movesets.description:
• Hyperspace Fury should be used against Cresselia, Dragapult, Serperior, and Pecharunt.
  • Gunk Shot is for non-defensive Ogerpon-W and Meowscarada.
  • Focus Blast is for Chien-Pao and Porygon-Z.
  • Thunderbolt is for non-Maranga Berry Corviknight, while Rock Tomb is for non-bulky Volcarona.
  • The HP and Special Defense EVs let Hoopa-U survive Timid Choice Scarf Porygon-Z's Hyper Beam. Maximum Speed EVs and a Jolly nature allow Hoopa-U to outspeed Modest Choice Scarf Porygon-Z and Dragapult and Speed tie opposing Choice Scarf Hoopa-U. The remaining EVs are in Attack.
  • Hoopa-U should use the strongest move it has in most cases. Other cases include trying to outplay a potential Custap Berry foe like Custap Berry Porygon-Z, picking a more accurate move in case two moves can KO, and using Hyperspace Fury to bypass Substitute and Protect.

movesets.name: Assault Vest
movesets.description:
• Assault Vest Hoopa-U is a strong check to powerful special attackers like Porygon-Z and Volcanion.
  • Psychic Noise deals strong damage to Fighting-types like Iron Valiant, as well as threatening victories against Pokemon that make use of their recovery to win battles, such as stall Azumarill and Pecharunt.
  • Knock Off allows Hoopa-U to damage other Psychic-types like Cresselia and Iron Crown while removing important items like Custap Berry from Sylveon and Life Orb from Porygon-Z that could otherwise threaten Hoopa-U's ability to win the matchup.
  • Gunk Shot threatens KOs against Fairy-type Pokemon like Primarina and Sylveon.
  • Drain Punch is used to defeat various Pokemon that Hoopa-U may want to recover HP from, such as non-Chople Berry Hisuian Goodra and Porygon-Z.
  • The HP and Special Defense EVs are used to bulk +2 Life Orb Porygon-Z's Hyper Beam after Knock Off, and the Speed EVs outspeed neutral-natured maximum investment base 50 speed Pokemon like Donphan. The rest of the EVs are dumped into Attack.
  • This set aims to act as a blanket check to many special attackers in the tier, such as Primarina and Porygon-Z. However, Assault Vest Hoopa-U may lack the immediate fire power to deal enough damage to Pokemon like Corviknight or have enough Speed to defeat other Pokemon like faster Hoopa-U.

movesets.name: Custap Berry
movesets.description:
• Psychic hits Poison-types like Pecharunt and Fighting-types like Urshifu-R, while Hyperspace Fury hits foes like Dragapult and Skeledirge.
  • Hyperspace Fury is useful because it ignores Spiky Shield from Ogerpon-W and Protect from other Custap Berry Pokemon.
  • Gunk Shot helps against Grass-types like Leech Seed Ogerpon-W and Whimsicott. It can also reliably hit Dark-types like Darkrai.
  • The HP and Defense investment helps Hoopa-U survive a Play Rough from Ogerpon-W, and the Speed EVs let it outspeed Donphan, but be careful because it has a chance to OHKO Hoopa-U with Earthquake. The remaining EVs are in Attack for maximum damage.
  • Against SubSeed Ogerpon-W, always use Gunk Shot until it is in range of Hyperspace Fury.
  • Pair Hoopa-U with something that can win against bulky Steel-types like Corviknight, Hisuian Goodra, and Registeel because Hyperspace Fury doesn't do enough damage, and they can KO it in return or use Iron Defense. Some good Pokemon for role that are Smack Down Landorus, Ursaluna-B, and Volcarona.

movesets.name: Choice Band
movesets.description:
Hoopa-U finds itself a niche as a powerful wallbreaker that leverages its STAB moves and coverage to decimate defensive Pokemon like Toxapex, Gholdengo, and Alomomola. Hyperspace Fury is a spammable option with Choice Band that ensures Pokemon like Alomomola and Gliscor cannot scout safely, as it bypasses Protect, leaving them unable to properly check Hoopa-U. Drain Punch targets foes like Kingambit and Heatran while increasing Hoopa-U's longevity. Gunk Shot eviscerates Clefable and Tapu Fini, which would otherwise check Hoopa-U. Knock Off is another option that can remove key items from foes like Landorus-T, Zapdos, and Moltres. Hoopa-U can run an Adamant nature to get guaranteed OHKOs on Toxapex with Zen Headbutt and Slowbro with Hyperspace Fury. However, this means it gets outsped by foes like defensive Landorus-T, offensive Heatran, and Timid Raging Bolt.

Hoopa-U is used on bulky offense and balance teams, as they value its ability to pressure common defensive cores including Pokemon such as Gliscor, Toxapex, and Heatran. However, Hoopa-U is very frail and provides little defensive value, so it appreciates teammates like Alomomola, Landorus-T, and Corviknight that can help it safely pivot into Pokemon it does well against, such as Gholdengo and Gliscor. Hoopa-U is also vulnerable to faster threats with U-turn like Landorus-T and Mega Lopunny; therefore, it appreciates defensive pieces that can take a hit such and provide slow pivoting such as Corviknight and Alomomola. Hoopa-U also has a very middling Speed tier, leaving it outsped by Pokemon like Mega Medicham, Volcarona, and Tapu Lele. Therefore, teammates like Iron Valiant, Garchomp, and Mega Scizor are appreciated to help offensively pressure them. In return, Hoopa-U handles Pecharunt, Slowbro, and Clefable for them. Hoopa-U is vulnerable to Pursuit trapping from Pokemon like Kingambit and Mega Tyranitar that target its weaker Defense stat; thus, Pokemon that can check them such as Zamazenta, Corviknight, and Great Tusk make for good partners. The latter two also provide crucial entry hazard removal to maintain Hoopa-U's longevity. Galarian Slowking is another partner that can get Hoopa-U in safely via Chilly Reception and set Future Fight to assist with breaking through bulkier teams while also being a solid check to foes like Iron Valiant and Tapu Koko, which force out Hoopa-U.

movesets.name: Assault Vest
movesets.description: 252 HP EVs and 56 Special Defense EVs let Hoopa-U live a Never-Ending Nightmare from a boosted Gholdengo when at full HP, 64 Attack EVs let it OHKO Kingambit with Drain Punch after Stealth Rock, and 16 Speed EVs let it outspeed Adamant Kingambit.
